biosample.biomaterial_provider: Matthew S. Tucker, Head Schistosomiasis Laboratory and Principal Investigator, Biomedical Research Institute, Rockville, Maryland, USA (NIH-NIAID Contract HHSN272201000005I)

description.comment: This sample group is the combination of the 2 individual BioSamples: SAMN10797287 and SAMN10797288. This S. haematobium strain is maintained in the Biomedical Research Institute, Rockville, Maryland in Bulinus truncatus (intermediate snail host) and Mesocricetus auratus (hamster; mammalian definitive host). Hamsters were each infected with 1,000 cercariae. After 90 days, paired adults of S. haematobium were collected from M. auratus, following the perfusion of the mesenteric and intestinal vessels using physiological saline (37 C). For long-read sequencing (PacBio), genomic DNA (~ 1 ug) was isolated from a single pair of adult worms (i.e. male and female in copula) of S. haematobium (SAMN10797288). To construct a long-range ('Chicago', Hi-C) linking library, used for scaffolding, genomic DNA was isolated from ~ 20 pairs of adult worms (i.e. male and female in copula) of S. haematobium (SAMN10797287).
